Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Ce programme est lancé pour tous les uti: This program is launched for all users: only an administrator can change it (Task Manager → Startup).
Les programmes qui se lancent avec Windo: The programs that launch with Windows, with their icon, origin and command, and a switch for each: like the Task Manager's Startup tab, using the same settings. Disabling uninstalls nothing, the change applies at the next startup; programs for all users stay reserved to the administrator.
Les programmes qui se lancent tout seuls: Programs that launch by themselves when you turn on the PC. Disabling one does not uninstall it: it simply no longer starts on its own, like in Task Manager. The change counts at the next start.
Rien n'est synchronisé : les programmes: Nothing is synchronized: the programs at startup are those of this PC.
au prochain démarrage de Windows: the next time you start Windows
